# jsPDF 4.2.1

Official standalone UMD build, vendored without code changes from:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parallax/jsPDF/v4.2.1/dist/jspdf.umd.min.js

License: MIT. Copyright and third-party notices are preserved in the file.

Loaded on demand from this application's origin for per-journey PDF exports.
No runtime CDN, HTML rendering, autoPrint, JavaScript PDF actions, or Node file loading is used.
